how_read: Read by eye from the y-axis labels of Figure 8a (page 7, rendered at 600 dpi) and checked against the bar labels of Figure 8b, which give the same 28 indices in the same order with the period of the Fourier probe each neuron is most aligned with, and against the dendrogram labels of Figure 45 (page 49), which list the same 28 indices. Section 5.1 defines the set as the layer-18 MLP neurons of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B with omega_addition > 0.4 (Eq. 6). The period is the cluster Figure 8a draws the neuron in; figure_8b_probe_period is the probe period of Figure 8b where it differs (8343: T=51; 6721 and 11096: T=99).
status: confirmed by Can Rager on 2026-09-29 against his screenshot of Figure 8a: the same 28 indices in the same order and the same six period groups (2 | 5 | 10 | 20 | 50 | 100); the paper releases no file of the indices
